description: This file defines the ApManager class, which manages Access Point (AP) operations including starting/stopping the AP, handling CMDU messages, managing BSS interfaces, and maintaining internal state and timers for the AP management process.

classes.name: ApManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing Wi-Fi Access Point operations, including message handling, BSS management, and state transitions.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the AP manager with interface name, logger, and shared resources.

methods.description: Starts the AP manager, enabling its operation.

methods.description: Stops the AP manager, halting its operation.
